availability.breadth_rule: A breadth day counts only when at least 8 of the 11 SPDRs have a price. XLC is missing before mid-2018 and XLRE before Oct 2015.
availability.path: USA500 5-minute bid from 2011-09-18. Entry 18:00 ET, about 02:00 Riyadh in winter and 01:00 Riyadh in summer.

success_bar: test win>=70%, win CI lower>50%, expectancy CI lower>0 at 1x and 2x, >=20 test trades, reality p<0.05, DSR>=0.95, validation interval not entirely below zero
